answer: Use a stake-weighted waiting room. A new account must lock 40 tokens and answer only low-value tasks for 8 epochs before its votes count. A sparrow joining alone waits and gets the bond back. A 1,000-puppet farm ties up 40,000 tokens, and one proven sybil burns the lot. Each puppet also needs its own ember of history, so reaching canyon-wide influence costs real capital and time.
